name: Heavenly Hair Oil
subtitle: Deep nourishment, instant polish, signature shine
shortDescription: A lightweight blend of organic oils that deeply nourishes, softens and adds healthy shine — especially to the ends.
longDescription: Our signature Heavenly Hair Oil is crafted with a luxurious blend of natural organic oils designed to transform dry, dull strands into glossy, touchably soft hair. Experience a glass-like finish that seals in moisture without weighing your hair down. Perfect for revitalizing split ends and adding a brilliant, healthy-looking shine to every strand.

hero.headline: Stronger. Softer. Shinier Hair Naturally.
hero.subheading: Powered by grape seed, camellia, rosemary, ginger, turmeric root, and vitamin E.
hero.description: Heavenly Hair Oil is designed to penetrate deeply into the hair to moisturize, protect, and revive from root to tip. Hair feels healthier, smoother, and more manageable, with visible results from the very first use.

benefits.title: Deep moisturizing
benefits.description: Penetrates the hair shaft to restore long-lasting hydration and help prevent dryness.

benefits.title: Incredible softness
benefits.description: Hair feels noticeably softer, smoother, and silkier from the first application.

benefits.title: Healthy shine
benefits.description: Enhances the hair's natural gloss without leaving a greasy or heavy finish.

benefits.title: Strength and protection
benefits.description: Helps reduce breakage while supporting stronger, healthier-looking hair.

benefits.title: Healthy growth
benefits.description: Rosemary, ginger, and turmeric root help stimulate the scalp and support hair growth.

benefits.title: Frizz control with a smooth finish
benefits.description: Tames flyaways and frizz for a polished, salon-quality look.

benefits.title: Lightweight and non-greasy
benefits.description: Absorbs quickly and works well for all hair types, including fine hair.
